name: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation
summary: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation provides district cooling services in the United Arab Emirates. The company operates through the Chilled Water and Pre-Insulated Pipe segments. It constructs, owns, assembles, installs, operates, and maintains cooling and conditioning systems; operates and maintains central cooling plants and related distribution networks; and distributes and sells chilled water for use in district cooling technologies. The company also offers pre-insulated pipes for district cooling services; air conditioning, ventilator, and refrigeration services; and repair and maintenance services. In addition, it engages in the installation and supply of air conditioning, ventilation, and air purification systems; and the provision of consultancy services for project development. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation is a subsidiary of Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (PJSC).
